entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ASP.NET fails to start on Linux #65518
  • Perf improvement: antiforgery-validation, fortunes #65517
  • OpenAPI schema transformers are not called for base types #65514
  • [Blazor] Add no-transform to the cache headers for the resource collection endpoint #65512
  • "The PipeWriter 'MeasuringPipeWriter' does not implement PipeWriter.UnflushedBytes" after update from .NET 8 to .NET 10 #65511
  • Auto-generated Program.cs does not have a namespace #65509
  • ASP.NET Core apps stop working on IIS after removing .NET Core 2.2.2 using dotnet-core-uninstall tool #65508

Closed
